blockers: C_required is not satisfied: the code requires opening the order card, but never verifies or mechanically requires using its information. A player can open-and-ignore it, choose the visually obvious chest option, and shoot when the UI explicitly says the breathing has stopped.

The instruction card directly reveals both mechanical answers—select the chest/lungs and press the shutter at the stopped-breath phase—matching the forbidden 'reading instructions reveals the answer button' pattern.
high: Replay depth is weak: a replay changes only which of three haze states is displayed; there is no alternative technique, tradeoff, or strategy to try.
Mastery is shallow and largely memorization: skilled play means repeating the single prescribed sequence and recognizing an intentionally conspicuous white haze.
medium: Progression is substantially fixed: invalid images cannot be submitted, and feedback explicitly sends the player back to the predetermined correct location or timing.
The lung-inspection interaction forces clicking both lungs before choices appear, but those clicks collect no player judgment and do not affect diagnosis or outcome.
The stated five-exposure limit is implemented as failure only when exposures exceed five, allowing a sixth exposure before failure.
low: Opening the order remains permanently recorded across retries and new cases, further weakening the relationship between consulting C and each case.

recommended_actions: Replace the answer-revealing order with case-specific imaging parameters that must be interpreted and applied through controls, such as target region, projection, positioning, or exposure settings.
Make incorrect settings produce diagnostically different images that the player must evaluate, rather than blocking advancement with corrective dialogue.
Remove the forced click-both-lungs gate and make focused inspection reveal subtle, case-specific evidence that affects the diagnosis.
Add case variation requiring different imaging decisions, not just a randomized haze location, so second plays support a different approach.
Create measurable mastery through balancing image quality, radiation use, positioning, and diagnostic confidence.
Correct the exposure threshold so the documented fifth-shot limit and failure behavior agree.
Reset orderOpened when restarting if consulting the new case order is intended to be required.
